 Adam Shapiro – Post-Breeding Grounds for Rising Stars and Families (Capital Allocators, EP.319) 
 
 Adam Shapiro – Post-Breeding Grounds for Rising Stars and Families (Capital Allocators, EP.319) Jun 5, 2023

 Adam Shapiro is the Managing
Partner of East Rock Capital, where he oversees $3 billion on
behalf of a handful of families investing primarily in hedge funds
and private deals alongside early-stage sponsors. Adam has recently
begun sharing his insights on a LinkedIn newsletter entitled “From
Star to Founder.”

Our conversation covers Adam’s background, his investment
objectives for families, and his process for achieving them. We
discuss East Rock’s assessment of managers, portfolio construction,
and risk management from their carefully selected set of ideas. We
close with Adam’s thoughts on family offices and the future of East
Rock.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
